wall_inference.method: outside bands around source interior-face polygons; gaps between rooms retain their source widths

limitations: Coordinates and source ceiling values are unverified model data, not as-built measurements.
External wall thickness is absent from MCP: 0.2m outside bands are an explicit modeling assumption.
Room ceiling heights preserve mixed source2.3/2.6m; never inherit168C2.5m override.
Per-instance opening dimensions are retained; frame/jamb visual thickness and operable leaf offsets are assumptions.
Rotations within0.2deg of cardinal axes use cardinal cutouts, recorded per opening; maximum edge offset under4mm.
Untyped areas are provisionally classified using door connections; tiny typed fragments retain source floors but are not walking starts.
Furniture and fixtures are omitted from this structural shell phase.
Supply211.99m² and exclusive164.39m² are metadata distinct from modeled floor polygon area.

entrance.identification_basis: source Entrance Door product plus interior living/hall on negative normal and no exterior room on positive normal

ceiling_unit_validation.basis: room ceilingHeight scalar values; all product and position dimensions are mm; placed entrances height2300mm and other doors2120mm fit 2.3m ceilings

area_accounting.note: Supply/exclusive areas are source unit metadata, not polygon sums; no fitting or global scaling applied.

opening_dimension_policy: all widths and heights from placed layout instances; no catalog fallback
